elements.__comment: Opaque casing. Carries the side texture on every face so the overlay below always has something behind it -- the front/back art is ~half transparent and the block renders on the cutout layer, so without this those pixels are holes straight through the block.
Front/back overlay, nudged 0.01 proud of the casing so it wins the depth test instead of z-fighting with it. Authored facing NORTH; MBD2 bakes a rotated copy per facing.
